text: Gomɗii yeddii ɓen Annasaarankooɓe wi'uɓe won- de : "Alla ko on woni Mema-sella geɗal Maryam on" ; tawde ɓe dammbirii Allankaaku ngun ko woori Alla, hara non Meme-sella geɗal Maryam on maa- kanno ɓe :"Ko onon yo ɓiɗɓe Israa'iila, rewee Alla Tun, ko Kanko woni Joomi am e Joomi mon, en fow ko en jeyaaɓe Makko. Mo kafidii Alla e goɗɗum, pellet, Alla Haɗay o naatugol Aljanna poomaa, ñiiɓirde makko nden kadi ko ka yiite, o maraa ballo ka Alla ton, wanaa le kadi daɗndoowo lepte ɗen".
